title: HTML Standards Audit
prompt: What should you do after a validator reports an error?
objective: Record at least three validation findings and the corrected markup for each.

options: Ignore it if the page looks acceptable
Read the diagnostic, identify the source, fix it, and validate again
Add more CSS so the warning is hidden

expected_output: A valid, inspectable HTML example demonstrating: validator errors, obsolete features.
acceptance_criteria: Read the diagnostic, identify the source, fix it, and validate again
hints: Validation is a feedback loop; the rendered page can conceal invalid source markup.
Review the connected lesson and make one focused revision at a time.
Run a validator or manually inspect the relevant browser behavior.

solution.answer: Read the diagnostic, identify the source, fix it, and validate again
solution.explanation: Reference approach: Validation is a feedback loop; the rendered page can conceal invalid source markup. Required structural evidence: <!doctype html>, <main>, <h1>.

grading_config.correct_answer: Read the diagnostic, identify the source, fix it, and validate again

retry_policy: Allow retries; only the first successful completion for this activity may award base XP. Incorrect submissions do not award XP.
status_note: Reference solution and grading configuration remain in backend content files; public exercise endpoints must omit them.
